_comment: Copy to config/local.json (git-ignored) and fill in locally. Never commit real values.

auth._clientIdNote: Public-client app registration in the lab tenant. Platform 'Mobile and desktop applications' with redirect URI http://localhost (MSAL interactive sign-in). Delegated permissions: DeviceManagementScripts.ReadWrite.All, DeviceManagementScripts.Read.All, GroupMember.Read.All. Scopes are fixed in tools/graph/lib/graphcore.py (ADR-035).
auth._tokenCacheNote: keychain = encrypted cache via msal-extensions (macOS Keychain); memory = sign in on every run. Never a plaintext file.

deploymentDefaults._note: runAsAccount, runAs32Bit and enforceSignatureCheck are fixed by the hard rules; the tools refuse other values.

promotion._note: Absolute device counts from the script's runSummary while only the pilot is assigned (ADR-035).

vm._note: Gate 4 test VM (ADR-017, ADR-029). Unenrolled, x64 Windows 11 Enterprise in Azure; reverted to a baseline snapshot before every scenario.
